findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: storyboard · Private data: get_collection, list_brands, get_brand, check_render · Public sink: get_formula, storyboard · Destructive: get_blueprint, list_formulas, get_formula, plan_video, check_render.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: storyboard · Private data: get_collection, list_brands, get_brand, check_render · Public sink: get_formula, storyboard · Destructive: get_blueprint, list_formulas, get_formula, plan_video, check_render

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
